Empty runs: Return trips without cargo
Customer inquiries: Many calls about shipment status
Documentation: Bills of lading, customs, hazmat are complex
Driver shortage: Hard to find qualified drivers
ai_opportunities: Route optimization: Optimize routes, sequence, time windows

Freight rate calculation: Quick quotes from inquiry
Document automation: Automatically create bills of lading, CMR
Customer chatbot: Shipment status, FAQs, bookings
Warehouse optimization: Storage locations, picking routes
typical_tools: Office: Excel for planning, Word for documents
Phone for dispatch and customer service
